verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public REST/GraphQL API, API reference, API keys, or developer endpoints for Thoropass. The closest item is an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant list audits and update evidence requests, but that belongs to the separate MCP-server story and does not count as a documented public API. The IP-allowlist and integration items describe Thoropass pulling data from connected tools, not a programmatic interface into Thoropass.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
